description: A tall, bearded man in a dark frock coat stands on a wooden platform, one arm raised, reading from pages on a lectern. Behind him a large domed white building with an unfinished, scaffolded dome and a construction crane. A dense crowd of men in top hats and dark coats fills the foreground, with soldiers in dark kepis holding rifles on the platform and a few armed figures on a balcony at right. The sky is heavy and overcast, and no text is visible.
